response.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY operation

assumptions.assumption: Large means an amount strictly greater than 2400.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff includes transactions of exactly 2400, use amount >= 2400.
